key_papers.findings: EfficientLEAF learnable Gabor filterbank + EfficientNet-B0 + 2D attention pooling + CTD metadata fusion. VTUAD combined-scenario accuracy: Domingos 84.13% -> CATFISH 96.63%. Metadata fusion ALONE: 91.59 -> 96.32. Background-class domain shift across SNR scenarios is THE failure mode (single-scenario 97% vs combined 84% with fixed filters)

key_papers.ref: Hummel et al. 2026 (Ecological Informatics) — linear probing study
key_papers.findings: 18 frozen pretrained encoders (AudioMAE, BEATs, HuBERT, Wav2Vec2...) + linear probe on DeepShip/ShipsEar: embedding geometry dominated by RECORDING-SPECIFIC variance, not ship type. Advice: diagnostic clustering, regularization, domain-informed pretraining; naive transfer underperforms
wind is the dominant driver (r>0.7 at 1-2.5 kHz); vessel detectability should be wind-detrended; band-ratio/shape features beat absolute levels across sites
